name: mediafetch
description: Multi-platform media downloader on Cloudflare Workers with in-browser audio/video muxing.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n vite,worker -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wrangler dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.secrets:optional: wrangler secret put RESOLVER_TOKEN && wrangler secret put BILIBILI_COOKIE && wrangler secret put INSTAGRAM_COOKIE
